title: Climate Organizations Map VERIFICATION
confirmation:
Thank you for taking the survey. The verification status will be updated within 7 days.

We will be in touch to share progress on the Localized Climate Action Initiative. To learn more about the Initiative or to contact us, go to: GreenCommunityCatalysts.com/localized-climate-action-initiative

sections.title: Climate Organizations Map VERIFICATION
sections.help:
Complete this short survey to provide accurate information about your organization on the Climate Organizations Map. See the image below for an example of the content we will publicly display.

Additional content collected by this survey will contribute to the ongoing research of the Localized Climate Action Initiative. This information will be summarized and not shared in any way that identifies the responder. 

Summarized findings are used to:
* identify barriers faced by climate-focused organizations and municipalities
* provide a framework to identify opportunities for solutions and collaboration, and 
* highlight communities with "climate action deserts" that need support

Your participation in the Map and the overall Initiative is intended to boost Adaptation and Mitigation efforts. More can be achieved when local climate-focused organizations and municipalities work collaboratively (not in silos) to build awareness, plan initiatives and implement projects in the community.

THANK YOU in advance for taking this survey.

Estimated completion time: 5-10 minutes
______________________________________________________________________

Map Verification status will be updated within 7 days of submission.

A link to Green Community Catalysts (GCC) and our Localized Climate Action Initiative, will be shared after submitting the survey.

questions.title: 7. What are the 3 Primary Barriers to achieving your organization’s goals/mission?

options.label: Not enough people to do the work (staff and volunteers)

Not enough money to pay staff
Not enough money for program implementation
Lack of support and/or collaboration from others in the community (municipality, business, other orgs, schools, etc.)
No one knows us in the community
Lack of strategic plan/direction to accomplish our mission/goals
We don’t have a mission and clear goals
